highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 corrects GPU rendering and clip handling while retaining Skia m157 and the managed API surface.

bullets.detail: Corrects transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle stroke widths and corner radii, and clamps corner radii to prevent overlap.
Empty flushes no longer leave stale token comparisons that make earlier atlas work appear pending in later flushes.

Counts the full effective clip stack when starting a render pass without double-counting recorded clips. Draws that cannot fit are warned about and skipped rather than exceeding pass capacity; passes exactly at the limit remain valid.
